headline: Werth's walk-off homer caps four-run ninth rally
recap: Trailing the Washington Nationals 6-3 entering the bottom of the ninth, the Phillies scored four runs without making an out to win 7-6. Placido Polanco led off with a single and Chase Utley doubled him to third, both scoring on a Ryan Howard single to make it 6-5. Jayson Werth then ended it with a two-run home run to center field off Nationals reliever Drew Storen, his 24th homer of the season.

Phillies starter Joe Blanton allowed four runs, including two home runs, on seven hits over six innings with eight strikeouts. Washington starter Yunesky Maya was pulled after 4.2 innings, having allowed three runs on six hits, and the Nationals padded their lead to 6-3 with three runs in the sixth and single runs in the seventh and eighth off Philadelphia's bullpen.

Storen was charged with the loss and his second blown save of the season after facing four batters and retiring none in the ninth. Vance Worley worked a scoreless ninth for the Phillies to pick up the win.
